title: Correct speed after 2s
description: Essential: Student must calculate v = v₀ + at = 8 + (-2)×2 = 4 m/s.

title: Correct stopping distance
description: Essential: Student must find stopping time (4 s) and compute x = v₀t + ½at² = 16 m.

title: Correct displacement after 3s
description: Essential: Student must compute x = 8×3 + ½×(-2)×3² = 15 m.

title: Proper sign handling
description: Important: Student must treat acceleration as negative (-2 m/s²) in all equations.

title: Stopping time calculation
description: Important: Student must find t_stop = (0 - v₀)/a = 4 s for part (2).

title: Units in final answers
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (m/s, m) with numerical answers.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Student uses a = +2 m/s² instead of -2 m/s², leading to wrong signs or values.

title: Confusing distance and displacement
description: Pitfall: For part (3), student incorrectly uses stopping formulas or computes distance traveled after stopping.
